title: Smartel Agritech says its soil-free farming systems use up to 90% less water

claims.text: Smartel Agritech says it uses hydroponics, which deliver nutrients directly through water, so that crops can be grown without soil.
The company says its systems use up to 90% less water than traditional farming.
claims.label: Less water than traditional farming

claims.text: Smartel says its focus is helping vulnerable communities in climate-arid regions grow food more sustainably.
The company says it offers farmers a 70/30 revenue-sharing model.
Smartel says its work aligns with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, including food security, water conservation and climate resilience.
The site displays logos of six partners and supporters, including the Diana Award and Mills Fabrica.
